claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActionRestriction.allow_only with attack rider narrowing
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Potion of Speed fits the existing magic_item + activation family, and most of Haste's positive effects already map to existing atoms. The blocker is the granted extra action: the current surface can only exclude standard action kinds, but Haste requires an allow-list and additionally constrains Attack to a single weapon attack.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you gain the effect of the Haste spell for 1 minute (no Concentration required)"
